question: If the volume of a cube is 729 cm³ then the measure of the main diagonal of the cube will be:
solution:
**Given:**

If the volume of a cube is 729 cm³, then the measure of the main diagonal of the cube will be:

**Formula used:**

Volume of a cube (V) = a³

Main diagonal of a cube = a√3

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd41748acfe75cee8c22bbbd5af819fc4a5320f1dc02d4f84058651e98f78363.png] 

Volume = 729 cm³

⇒ a³ = 729

⇒ a = 9 cm

Main diagonal = a√3

⇒ Main diagonal = 9√3 cm

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
